concept.title: Clair in disconnected environments
concept.shortdesc: Clair supports disconnected Red Hat Quay deployments that have no direct internet access. You can use the clairctl tool to transfer vulnerability database updates from an open host so Clair can scan images offline.

conbody.p: Clair uses a set of components called updaters to handle the fetching and parsing of data from various vulnerability databases. By default, updaters pull vulnerability data directly from the internet and work for immediate use.

note.p: Currently, Clair enrichment data is CVSS data. Enrichment data is currently unsupported in disconnected environments.
